sentences.text:
Author: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
Bench: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
 Criminal Petition Nos. 2109, 2110, 2114, 2117 and 2118
 Of 2020
Common Order:

-
All these petitions are filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 to quash the crimes registered against them for the offences punishable under sections 273 and 188 IPC and under Sections 57, 58 r/w 26 and 30 of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 (for short, 'the FSS Act').
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor.

3. When the matters are taken up for hearing, both the learned counsel for the petitioners in all these petitions and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor submits that the matter is squarely covered by earlier orders of this court, whereunder proceedings initiated against the accused therein on similar set of facts for the aforesaid offences, are quashed by this court, as not maintainable.
They have also produced the copies of the orders passed by this court in Crl.P.No.100 of 2020, dated 08.01.2020 and Crl.P.No.4876 of 2019, dated 22.08.2019.

4. As can be seen from the aforesaid two orders produced by the learned counsel for the petitioners,
it is evident that proceedings initiated against the petitioners therein for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273 and 328 of IPC and Sections 57, 58 r/w Sections 26 and 30 of the FSS Act on the basis of similar facts, were quashed by this court on the ground that tobacco product would not fall within the definition of food defined under Section 3(j) of FSS Act and as such, police are not authorized to register the crime.
5.

Therefore, in view of the aforesaid orders, as the present crimes in all these criminal petitions registered for the aforesaid offences are squarely covered by the above judgments, these Criminal Petitions are allowed and the proceedings initiated against the petitioners in all these criminal petitions, are hereby quashed.
Miscellaneous Petitions, if any pending, in this Criminal Petition, shall stand closed.
